crossRefs.note: Yahweh said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of…

translations.web: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”
translations.bsb: “Who told you that you were naked?” asked the LORD God. “Have you eaten from the tree of which I commanded you not to eat?”
translations.kjv: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
translations.asv: And he said, Who told thee that thou wast naked? Hast thou eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded thee that thou shouldest not eat?
